top_improvements: Security and isolation coverage improved: live explicitly handles tenant/user/confidential/regulated/auth/session/secret-bearing constraints.
Operational controls improved: live adds manual purge, rollout/rollback states, policy versions, stale-if-error gating, audit events, and disablement without deployment.

structural_failure_interpretation: Mixed. Missing Provenance is a real quality regression. The Risks failure is quality-relevant to the checker but partly a table-vs-enumerated-item mismatch because the live artifact has a risk table. Missing agent_spec persona/model aliases are mainly metadata/contract regressions, not direct merged-requirements content failures. Functional, NFR, AC, open-question, handoff, artifact-completeness, and adversarial-directory checks pass.
adversarial_reason: No unresolved tie, contradictory evidence, or high-stakes ambiguity. Baseline clearly wins implementation-readiness/provenance while live clearly wins generic coverage/tasklist fit; remediation is straightforward rather than requiring adversarial arbitration.
